title: Tensor cancellation for one finite quotient module
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra map $i:E\to F$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E$, $B=\mathcal O_F$ with their chosen uniformizers $t,v$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Fix a scheme $W$ and $e\geq1$ with $(t)B=(v^e)$, using the ramification datum and finite coefficient maps of [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Let $n\geq0$, $A_n=A/(t^{n+1})$, $B_n=B/(v^{e(n+1)})$, and let $M$ be a module sheaf over the constant sheaf of $A_n$ on the small pro-etale site of $W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Restrict $M$ to the constant sheaf of $A$ using its completed quotient projection and the constant-to-completion map [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. There exists a $B$-linear isomorphism $B\otimes_A\operatorname{Res}_A M\cong\operatorname{Res}_B(B_n\otimes_{A_n}M)$, with both ordinary tensors the specified sheafified scalar functors [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower, def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-adjunction]. On each site object it sends the sheafified pure tensor $b\otimes x$ to $\overline b\otimes x$, where $\overline b$ is the image under the constant-to-completion map followed by the specified positive finite quotient projection. Only existence for this single $M,n$ is asserted; no uniqueness or naturality of these witnesses is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03EK, lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict; the tensor/quotient construction in Step 7 and finiteOrdinaryBalancing_existsUnique docstring of lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-mate.

proof.text: Apply the ring-only ramified quotient section pushout to the four actual coefficient maps, at every pro-etale site object. This contains only the ramification and constant finite quotient calculation.

For a commutative-ring pushout A→B, A→C, B→D, C→D, use CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout and Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChange to obtain the B-linear isomorphism B tensor_A M ≅ Res_B(D tensor_C M). The symm_tmul lemma gives b tensor m ↦ p(b) tensor m. Tensor induction and naturality of p show these objectwise isomorphisms commute with restrictions.

Sheafify the presheaf isomorphism. Use the restriction/sheafification isomorphism, whose underlying additive-sheaf map is identity, to reach restriction of the target sheafified tensor. Transport through the object equations of pbcExtend. Naturality of the sheafification unit proves the displayed pure tensor formula after cancelling the object transports. Restriction along a composite agrees with the two displayed restriction functors.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotientModuleBalancing_exists (W : Scheme.{u}) (e : ℕ)
    (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e) (hepos : 1 ≤ e) (n : ℕ)
    (M : pbcModules W ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1)
      (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).ring W)) :
    ∃ β : (pbcExtend (constantMap l E F i W)).obj
        ((pbcRestrict (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1)
          (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) W) ⋙
          SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
            (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E W)).obj M) ≅
      (pbcRestrict (PurCompactSupport.projection l F (e * (n + 1))
          (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) W) ⋙
        SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
            (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l F W)).obj
        ((pbcExtend ((PurCompactSupport.finiteChange l E F i e he hepos (n + 1)
          (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).map W)).obj M),
      ∀ (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : ((constants l F).ring W).obj.obj U) (x : M.val.obj U),
        β.hom.val.app U
            (pbcTensorSection (constantMap l E F i W)
              ((pbcRestrict (PurCompactSupport.projection l E (n + 1)
                (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) W) ⋙
                SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
                  (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E W)).obj M) U b x) =
          pbcTensorSection
            ((PurCompactSupport.finiteChange l E F i e he hepos (n + 1)
              (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)).map W) M U
            (((PurCompactSupport.projection l F (e * (n + 1))
              (Nat.mul_pos hepos (Nat.le_add_left 1 n)) W).hom.app U)
              (((integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l F W).hom.app U) b)) x
